FOLLOW THE LEADER.
With powerful TwinPower Turbo engines, intelligent lightweight construction and Integral Active Steering
for first-class handling and agility, the BMW 5 Series is designed for an ultimate driving experience – and always
being one step ahead of the competition.
Not all features are available on all models. Get the latest information on standard and optional features, packages and technical specifications. Visit bmwusa.com and select the BMW model of your choice.

and a Bowers & Wilkins® Diamond Surround Sound System, the interior of the 5 Series will transport both you
and your senses with ease.
